name: @hheei/pi-starship
description: HEPI fork of pi-starship, a native Starship-style Pi statusline.

scripts.check: biome check --vcs-use-ignore-file=false src test package.json tsconfig.json README.md NOTICES.md && npm run typecheck
scripts.format: biome check --write --vcs-use-ignore-file=false src test package.json tsconfig.json README.md NOTICES.md
